facts: platform-tools must be installed into the SDK root by sdkmanager, not only as the Homebrew cask.
The emulator validates the SDK root by looking for that directory, while adb on PATH works regardless, so the error points the wrong way.
mobium doctor checks for it: an SDK root with no platform-tools directory is reported, with sdkmanager platform-tools as the remedy.
note: SETUP's two traps answers it; CHALLENGES 'Environment traps' carries the same trap in the same words and came back second, so ADD it. Doctor fact checked against internal/agent/doctor.go:103-117.
